name: Md Mozammel Hossain
summary: Embedded software developer in Germany with experience in Embedded Linux, custom Linux distributions, Windows IoT/OS image development, and industrial software solutions. Current work at INB Vision GmbH focuses on Yocto and OpenEmbedded Linux distributions, C/C++ and Qt applications, Conan/CMake packaging, CI/CD, secure update workflows, and software for industrial sensor systems. Previous BMW Group work included Industry 4.0, digital twin integration, and predictive-maintenance solutions for EV engine production.
